rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the place where scientific testing or research is done.

example.english: We are doing tests in the lab.
example.traditional: 我哋喺實驗室做緊測試。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 sat6 jim6 sat1 zou6 gan2 caak1 si3

rows.note: Use this for the experiment, test, or lab assignment itself rather than the room.

example.english: The lab produced a surprising result.
example.traditional: 呢個實驗嘅結果幾令人意外。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sat6 jim6 ge3 git3 gwo2 gei2 ling6 jan4 ji3 ngoi6

rows.note: Use this when the hands-on activity is a practical laboratory class or workshop.

example.english: I have lab tomorrow, so I can't go out.
example.traditional: 我聽日有實驗課，唔可以去街。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jau5 sat6 jim6 fo3 m4 ho2 ji5 heoi3 gaai1
